why: Reading .stdout straight off subprocess.run loses the return code, so a failed tool looks like an empty result and a gate goes green. A tool's failure and nothing to report must never give the same output.
good:
names = subprocess.run(["git", "diff"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
r = subprocess.run(cmd)
if r.returncode:
    fail()
